往往让每张卡处理不同 prompt，并在本地生成多个样本；LeanGRPO 改成所有卡处理同一个 prompt，但各自生成不同样本。这样每个 rank 不需要同时保留同一 prompt 下多个样本的图。第二层是两种无重算训练日程。\n\nLeanGRPO-Retain 在 rollout 时直接开梯度，保留被选 timestep 的计算图，等终端 reward 和 advantage Views continuous rewards as a family of binary success events (exceeding a threshold). TailRL maximizes the log-probability of exceeding a uniformly chosen reward threshold. Its gradient decomposes into a harmonic mixture of Best-of-k gradients. TailRL provides an unbiased finite-rollout estimator that can be implemented simply by swapping the advantage function in existing RL pipelines (e.g., GRPO/RLOO).","experiments":"TailRL performs strongly across object localization, maze navigation, GUI grounding, and code optimization. Weight adaptation trains LoRA adapters at test time with DPO, preferring the human-guided final artifact over the agent’s initial attempt. This captures more persistent behavioral changes and reduces pressure on the context window. The interface collects several signal types: textual messages, plan revisions, rubric specifications, and direct edits to deliverables. distillation for reasoning. OPD usually supervises every generated token on student-induced trajectories, and its advantage over RL-style training is often attributed to this dense signal. The authors stress-test that assumption by removing almost all supervised positions. The main finding is sharp: supervising only one or two tokens per reasoning trajectory, around 0.05% of all generated tokens, can still improve reasoning substantially and often matches or beats full-token OPD.","importance":"The contribution is primarily mechanistic and training-signal oriented. It suggests that reasoning gains from OPD are not simply a consequence of imitating the teacher distribution everywhere. A tiny number of high-leverage token updates can be enough to move the model toward better reasoning behavior. This matters for post-training efficiency, but more importantly it changes how OPD should be interpreted. The strongest sparse variants do not necessarily reduce teacher-student reverse KL; some even increase it. That weakens the common explanation that OPD works mainly by distribution matching. For pretraining researchers, the useful lesson is broader: supervision density and supervision quality are separable. Token-level data selection may matter as much as, or more than, the nominal amount of supervised text.","technical_approach":"The method starts from sampled-token OPD. In standard OPD, the student generates on-policy trajectories and receives teacher distribution supervision at each position, which corresponds to minimizing a teacher-student reverse KL objective. The paper keeps the rollout setting fixed and changes only the supervised token subset. It studies random one-token supervision per trajectory and more selective variants that keep tokens with extreme teacher-student probability differences. This selection lets the authors separate positive teacher-preferred tokens from negative teacher-dispreferred tokens and inspect their effects under different teacher-student scale regimes. The key distinction from RLVR is that these token signals are local teacher preferences, not outcome-level credit assignment. The key distinction from dense OPD is that almost all token-level imitation targets are deliberately discarded.","experiments":"$5e","reading_guide":"Read the objective and token-selection sections carefully. When reading the experiments, check whether sparse losses are rescaled, where selected tokens tend to occur in the trajectory, how trajectory length is handled, and whether sampling temperature affects the result. 的核心命题是：最合适的教师不是另一个模型，而是“模型沿着已验证改进方向的未来自己”，并且可以从训练轨迹中近似出来。","importance":"对预训练/后训练闭环的意义在于：它提供了一种把 RLVR 的稀疏信号“蒸馏化”的通用接口，把 outcome-driven 的参数位移转成 token-level target，从而在不增加采样成本、也不依赖外部 teacher 轨迹与可验证奖励，就能递归地产生更密的监督信号。","technical_approach":"RISE 把一次 RLVR 更新视为“已被奖励验证过的改进方向”。设第 n 轮策略为 π_{θ_n}，经 RLVR 得到更新后的 π_{θ'_{n+1}}。选择一个表示映射 φ，把策略映射到可线性运算的向量空间（论文给出两类实例：参数空间与 logit/分布空间）。用一个较早的锚点（trailing anchor）θ_n 与当前更新后 checkpoint θ'_{n+1} 的位移 Δ = φ(π_{θ'_{n+1}}) − φ(π_{θ_n}) 作为“近期改进方向”，然后做外推：φ(teacher) = φ(π_{θ'_{n+1}}) + (β−1)·Δ，其中 β>1 表示向前投影到“未来更好”的教师；β=1 退化为无信号（teacher=student）。\n\n两种实例化：\n1) Weight-space extrapolation（φ=θ）：直接在参数上做 task arithmetic 式外推，得到 θ_future = θ'_{n+1} + (β−1)(θ'_{n+1}−θ_n)，teacher 是一个显式模型。优点是概念直接；代价是需要额外前向（teacher 推理）与可能的数值/泛化风险（外推过头）。\n2) Logit-space extrapolation（φ=logits/next-token distribution）：在输出分布层面做几何混合/外推，teacher 是每个位置的目标分布，不一定需要显式构造一个完整“外推后的参数模型”。优点是更贴近 OPD 的 token-level 监督形式，计算/工程上可能更轻；代价是需要定义合理的分布外推方式并处理概率单纯形约束。\n\n训练循环上，RISE 把 RLVR 与 OPD 组合成递归：RLVR 负责“方向正确”（把位移锚定在可验证改进上），OPD 负责“把方向变成逐 token 的可学习目标”（用 teacher 分布做 KL/CE 蒸馏）。关键取舍是：外推本身不判断好坏，只会放大更新；因此必须用 RLVR 先产生相对可靠的更新，再外推蒸馏。","experiments":"从引言给出的全文信息看，作者在数学推理、多域 STEM、代码生成、多轮 accuracy 背后的机制。核心发现是：决定收益的主要不是 reviewer 自己会不会做题，而是它能否稳定识别该拒绝的答案；而 self-review 看起来“安全”，很多时候只是因为 executor 没有采纳错误 critique，而不是 reviewer 真有判断力。","importance":"对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对 post-train pipeline LLM judge。\n\n真正的创新不在 pipeline 结构，而在 rejection-outcome decomposition。作者不只统计 reviewer 拒绝了多少次，而是逐个 reject 追踪：原答案是否错、修订后是否变对、原答案是否本来对却被改坏、错误 critique 是否被 executor 忽略。这个拆解让两个常见误判暴露出来。其一，self-review 的高拒绝率不等于高价值，因为它会大量误拒正确答案。其二，低 damage rate 也不一定说明 reviewer 好，可能只是 executor 没听 reviewer 的。换句话说，reviewer 质量和 executor 的 critique uptake 是两个不同变量，必须分开看。","experiments":"关键结果很集中。固定 executor 单独做题时，100 道 detection rate 最高，但最终准确率没有显著提升。文中给出的细节是：它的 reject 次数约为有效中等 reviewer 的 2.1 倍，但修好的错误答案只有后者的约三分之一；同时，它会错误拒绝自己 35% 的正确答案。更关键的是，在这些 false rejection 里，只要 executor 真的按 critique 去改，结果都会变错；那些没有造成最终伤害的样本，只是因为 约束带来的自动对称性打破。即便初始化无信息，只要满足一个温和的非退化条件，W 的动力学会自发选出一个有偏方向，从而在 Θ(d^2 log d) 样本量上实现 weak recovery。untied 分解则不是靠 PSD 结构，而是出现 fast-slow 机制：1/sqrt(d) Tr(UV^T) 这样的 pre-activation mean 在快时间尺度先演化，形成一个 boundary It shows that a single scalar notion of tool trust is too coarse: the same source can be accepted or resisted depending on the candidate answer and the receiver model. A particularly useful message is that a model’s own characteristic errors are dangerous when external systems reproduce them. External evidence is modeled as a candidate-specific operator on the receiver’s pre-existing answer distribution, decomposed into a receiver prior weight and an evidence tilt. A Bayesian receiver appears as the prior-consistent case, while scalar source trust is only a narrower special case under uniform error assumptions. The empirical design separates generation, checking, and use. Candidate support and receiver competence are measured before the candidate is shown; cross-fitting and matched designs are used to separate prior support from recruited verification. The paper defines recruitment as the causal gain by which the model’s own verification signal affects final use. This makes it possible to distinguish internal evaluation, verbalized rejection, and actual decision control. 暴露模型弱点，再围绕这些弱点生成新环境，但这种方式容易被当前策略和初始环境分布绑住，随着模型变强，失败样本变少，环境生成也会逐渐失去驱动力。论文的核心问题是：能否不依赖当前 rollout 模型，而是离线、持续地把已有环境沿着可控方向演化成更难但仍可验证的环境，从而为长周期 agent RL 提供更持久的训练分布。","importance":"这篇工作和传统 LLM 预训练距离较远，但对 agent RL 里与 pretrain data mixture 有相似结构。第二，off-policy environment evolution 试图把“难度”定义为环境属性，而不是某个当前模型的失败率，这对构建更稳健的训练 curriculum 有意义。量级上，这是训练数据/环境供给侧的工作，不是模型架构或优化范式的改变。","technical_approach":"方法核心是 lineages。这个 lineage 设计很重要，因为它不是从零生成全新环境，而是在已有可验证环境上做局部、可控、可追踪的难化，既保留了 correctness，也更容易形成 curriculum。训练时再按 generation-by-generation 的方式调度这些演化环境，让模型在不同阶段持续接收到尚未饱和的学习信号。\n\n与 co-evolution 的区别主要有两点：一是
